security_properties.property: MODEXP precompile MUST parse and validate length parameters BEFORE beginning computation
security_properties.rationale: Computing before validation could trigger resource exhaustion attacks with large inputs

security_properties.property: length_of_BASE MUST NOT exceed 1024 bytes (8192 bits)
security_properties.rationale: Unbounded base size could enable consensus bugs due to implementation differences at large inputs

security_properties.property: length_of_EXPONENT MUST NOT exceed 1024 bytes (8192 bits)
security_properties.rationale: Large exponents are computationally expensive and could enable timing-based consensus failures

security_properties.property: length_of_MODULUS MUST NOT exceed 1024 bytes (8192 bits)
security_properties.rationale: Large modulus values increase computational complexity and test surface area

security_properties.property: Length limit violation MUST consume all gas allocated to the call and return error
security_properties.rationale: Partial gas refund would make attack attempts economically viable

security_properties.property: MODEXP calculation SHALL only proceed after all three length parameters pass validation
security_properties.rationale: Processing with any invalid parameter could trigger undefined behavior

security_properties.property: External caller input MUST be validated against 1024-byte bounds before processing
security_properties.rationale: Untrusted callers can provide arbitrary input data to the precompile

security_properties.property: Large input attacks MUST be rejected at validation stage without complex processing
security_properties.rationale: Early rejection prevents resource exhaustion before computation begins

security_properties.property: Input bounds MUST create a finite, testable input domain
security_properties.rationale: Unbounded inputs make exhaustive testing impossible, increasing risk of consensus bugs

security_properties.property: Malicious actor attempts to submit oversized inputs MUST be rejected with gas penalty
security_properties.rationale: Without penalty, attackers could spam validation attempts cheaply

security_properties.property: Input limit violation MUST consume ALL remaining gas provided to the call
security_properties.rationale: Full gas consumption economically penalizes attack attempts

security_properties.property: Length check MUST occur before complex gas pricing calculation
security_properties.rationale: Processing pricing for invalid inputs wastes resources and may trigger bugs (AMB-EIP7823-02)

security_properties.property: All client implementations MUST implement identical bounds checking logic
security_properties.rationale: Different implementations could cause consensus failures (ASSUM-EIP7823-03)

security_properties.property: Whisper status message (0x00) exchange MUST complete before envelope exchange
security_properties.rationale: Sending envelopes before handshake could cause undefined protocol state

security_properties.property: Peer connections MUST NOT exchange application envelopes until handshake completes
security_properties.rationale: Pre-handshake messages could bypass PoW and bloom filter requirements

security_properties.property: PoW and bloom filter requirements from status message MUST be enforced for the session
security_properties.rationale: Ignoring negotiated parameters defeats spam protection

security_properties.property: Envelope structure MUST be validated before PoW and bloom filter checks
security_properties.rationale: Malformed envelopes could cause parsing errors or crashes during validation

security_properties.property: Envelope PoW value MUST NOT be NaN, INF, or negative
security_properties.rationale: Invalid PoW values could bypass spam protection or cause calculation errors

security_properties.property: Invalid envelopes MUST be silently dropped without crashing the node
security_properties.rationale: Crash-inducing packets could enable DoS attacks

security_properties.property: Severe protocol violations MUST trigger peer disconnection
security_properties.rationale: Maintaining connections with misbehaving peers wastes resources

security_properties.property: Messages MUST be encrypted with ECIES or AES-GCM before transmission
security_properties.rationale: Unencrypted messages would leak content to network observers

security_properties.property: Messages MUST be signed with ECDSA before transmission for authenticity
security_properties.rationale: Unsigned messages cannot be verified as coming from claimed sender

security_properties.property: Messages MUST have 256-byte alignment padding applied to prevent size-based metadata leakage
security_properties.rationale: Message size can reveal content characteristics to passive observers

security_properties.property: Application plaintext messages MUST NOT be transmitted unencrypted
security_properties.rationale: Transmitting plaintext would completely compromise message confidentiality

security_properties.property: Decryption SHALL only succeed with correct encryption keys
security_properties.rationale: Weak encryption would allow unauthorized message access

security_properties.property: ECIES and AES-GCM encryption MUST remain secure within message TTL timeframe
security_properties.rationale: If encryption can be broken during TTL, message confidentiality is compromised (ASSUM-EIP627-01)

security_properties.property: SET_CODE transaction (type 0x05) MUST contain authorization list for processing
security_properties.rationale: Missing authorization list would make the transaction invalid

security_properties.property: Authorization chain_id MUST match current chain ID or be 0 (universal)
security_properties.rationale: Cross-chain replay of authorizations could enable unauthorized delegations

security_properties.property: Authorization nonce MUST be less than U64.MAX to prevent overflow
security_properties.rationale: Nonce overflow could enable replay attacks or undefined behavior

security_properties.property: Authority account nonce MUST exactly match authorization nonce
security_properties.rationale: Nonce mismatch prevents replay of old or premature authorizations

security_properties.property: Account MUST have empty code or valid existing delegation before new delegation
security_properties.rationale: Overwriting non-delegation contract code would destroy existing functionality

security_properties.property: Delegation code MUST be set to 0xef0100 followed by 20-byte target address
security_properties.rationale: Incorrect format would not be recognized as delegation by other components

security_properties.property: Authority nonce MUST be incremented after successful delegation application
security_properties.rationale: Without increment, the same authorization could be replayed

security_properties.property: Failed authorization validations MUST skip to next authorization without transaction failure
security_properties.rationale: Single invalid authorization should not invalidate entire transaction

security_properties.property: External user authorization submissions MUST be cryptographically validated
security_properties.rationale: Unvalidated authorizations could enable unauthorized delegations

security_properties.property: y_parity MUST be exactly 0 or 1 for valid ECDSA signature
security_properties.rationale: Invalid y_parity indicates malformed or manipulated signature

security_properties.property: Signature r value MUST be within secp256k1 curve order (0 < r < n)
security_properties.rationale: r outside curve order is invalid and could enable signature forgery

security_properties.property: Signature s value MUST be within secp256k1 curve order (0 < s < n)
security_properties.rationale: s outside curve order is invalid and could enable signature forgery

security_properties.property: Signing hash MUST be computed as keccak256(0x05 || RLP(chain_id, address, nonce))
security_properties.rationale: Incorrect hash format would cause valid signatures to be rejected or invalid to be accepted

security_properties.property: ECDSA recovery failure MUST result in InvalidSignatureError
security_properties.rationale: Accepting failed recoveries could enable processing of forged authorizations

security_properties.property: Cold address access MUST cost 2600 gas; warm access MUST cost 100 gas
security_properties.rationale: Incorrect pricing could enable gas-related attacks or break economic assumptions

security_properties.property: Accessed addresses MUST be added to warm set after first access
security_properties.rationale: Failure to track warm addresses would result in overcharging on repeated access

security_properties.property: Valid delegation code MUST be exactly 23 bytes (EOA_DELEGATED_CODE_LENGTH)
security_properties.rationale: Different lengths indicate either non-delegation code or corrupted delegation

security_properties.property: Valid delegation code MUST start with 0xef0100 marker (EOA_DELEGATION_MARKER)
security_properties.rationale: Missing marker indicates non-delegation bytecode that should not be treated as delegation

security_properties.property: Target address extraction MUST correctly parse 20 bytes following the 3-byte marker
security_properties.rationale: Incorrect extraction could route calls to wrong address

security_properties.property: ECDSA signatures MUST NOT be forgeable for unauthorized delegations
security_properties.rationale: Signature forgery would enable hijacking of EOAs (ASSUM-EOA-DELEG-01)

security_properties.property: 0xef0100 marker MUST NOT conflict with valid EVM bytecode prefixes
security_properties.rationale: Conflicts could cause legitimate contracts to be misinterpreted as delegations (ASSUM-EOA-DELEG-05)

security_properties.property: Setting delegation target to NULL_ADDRESS MUST result in empty code (delegation revocation)
security_properties.rationale: Behavior for null target needs to be clearly defined (AMB-EOA-DELEG-01)
